display_information.name: MyMultiSig
display_information.description: Multisig request notifications and read-only chain lookups for your Slack channels.
display_information.long_description:
MyMultiSig posts a message into your Slack channels whenever a new transaction request is proposed on one of your multisig wallets, and again when a request collects enough signatures to be executed. Each message links straight to the request page so signers can review and sign in one click.

Getting started:
1. Add the app to your workspace from https://mymultisig.app/settings/slack (sign in with your wallet first).
2. In the channel that should get notifications, run /bind <chain> <multisig address>. For private channels, /invite the bot first.
3. That's it. Run /multisig help any time for the full command list.

The bot never holds keys and cannot sign or execute anything; signing always happens in your own wallet on mymultisig.app.
